fields.options:
Jinja templating is supported in Subject, HTML, CSS and JS fields.

Available context:
doc — full Department Report document. Examples: {{ doc.department }}, {{ doc.department_head }}, {{ doc.report_type }}, {{ doc.report_date }}, {{ doc.support_needed_from_md }}, {{ doc.overall_remarks }}.

Child tables on doc: doc.completed_items, doc.ongoing_items, doc.pending_items, doc.blockers, doc.daily_timeline, doc.kpi_metrics — iterate with {% for item in doc.completed_items %}...{% endfor %}.

Helpers: {{ period }} (formatted period), {{ report_link }} (full URL).

Frappe utilities: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.report_date) }}, {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(123.45) }}.

Loop example:
<table>
  {% for item in doc.completed_items %}
  <tr>
    <td>{{ item.title }}</td>
    <td>{{ item.priority or '-' }}</td>
  </tr>
  {% endfor %}
</table>
Conditional example:
{% if doc.support_needed_from_md %}
  <p>{{ doc.support_needed_from_md }}</p>
{% endif %}
